# Tamedia & GrowthBook | Enterprise Proof of Concept & further technical conversation
Date: 2026-10-08 | Duration: 42.900001525878906m

## Summary
The discussion covered Cloud Function performance, optimization, legal compliance, product integration, and coordination. Cold starts create high compute time, while continuous traffic keeps the function warm at about 60% utilization, below the roughly 70% comfort threshold. The current compute budget supports three concurrent experiments, with an increase to four being tested. The fnv32a function was optimized, with an engineering review planned for next week. Profiling used a custom Linux tool and AI-assisted iteration rather than the Java V8 profiler. A partial SDK was reimplemented for Cloudflare while preserving behavior, edge caching, and cost optimizations. GDPR compliance for a GB UUID used by anonymous users remains under review, and the data privacy officer is expected to respond in about one week. A fallback would limit experiments to subscribed users. Code-based experiments are preferred over the Visual Editor, with API and CLI interfaces available and possible CMS integration. PM onboarding is planned after legal clearance. Slack supports coordination, with Natasha added for support access. CMP and cookie consent are the next priority, followed by biweekly check-ins after legal clearance.

## Keywords
Cloudflare function, GDPR compliance, fnv32a optimization, Proof of Concept, Visual Editor, experiment concurrency

# Tamedia & GrowthBook | Platform Demo for Product Team
Date: 2026-10-15 | Duration: 54m

## Summary
Growthbook is an open-source tool created by the education.com CTO and CFO, offering feature flags, experiments, and product analytics for companies of different sizes. Feature flags dynamically enable features, while experiments support audience targeting and unlimited variants. Growthbook connects to a customer’s data warehouse, which remains the single source of truth; it does not store data itself. Teams can ramp rollouts by percentage and time, use guardrail metrics with automatic kill switches, and separate mutually exclusive experiments through namespaces. Metrics are defined and computed in the warehouse, with support for existing BI metrics, custom definitions, Google Analytics, and AWS Athena. Exposure events connect to user IDs for experiment and cohort analysis, while polling frequency controls data freshness and query cost. Server-side deployment is preferred to avoid content shifts and SEO impact, although client-side and edge deployments are supported. A visual editor handles simple UI changes, while complex features require coding. Product managers can run experiments with data-team collaboration, and follow-up metric planning and integration discussions were planned, with Slack available for support.

## Keywords
Feature Flagging, Experimentation, Data Warehouse Integration, A/B Testing, Server-Side Rendering, Product Analytics

# Tamedia & GrowthBook | Commercial Discussion
Date: 2026-10-15 | Duration: 27.780000686645508m

## Summary
The discussion compared cloud SaaS and self-hosting, with a preference for SaaS and an EU cloud option available. Self-hosting would add operational work, while cloud hosting would cost approximately 20k CHF more under the enterprise model. Enterprise pricing includes a base fee and per-user licensing, with no traffic or event costs; the Pro version is limited to 30 users, lacks SSO and support, and includes CDN fees. The group discussed building an experimentation culture around defined metrics, learning, and growth, including a possible AI assistant for experiment insights. Adoption and ROI depend on effective team usage, so a product team session and trial were planned. There is no fixed production timeline, and budget impact for 2027 needs assessment. Payment installments, contractual adjustments, technical support through Remy, and possible leadership escalation on pricing were also offered.

## Keywords
Growth Book, self-hosting, cloud hosting, commercial model, experimentation program, enterprise pricing

# Tamedia & GrowthBook | Trial Setup + Timeline
Date: 2026-10-27 | Duration: 36m

## Summary
The team will test prominent and subtle button variants with identical functionality for the biggest brand, building on the preferred-source button already live on Venkatfer. The design discussion focuses on prominence, visibility, subtlety, and opt-in behavior, with evidence needed to support internal decisions. Success measures must be defined, variant performance compared, and results summarized after the trial. Data-collection questions were resolved with Alessandro, but production setup, GA4 exposure-event integration, warehouse delivery, feature-flag creation, and experiment linkage remain required. The custom implementation will use Google Analytics rather than an SDK or tracking callback. The free version can support setup, while enterprise capabilities require trial-license access; Rémy is preparing the license, and continuation will depend on results. Designs are targeted for completion this week, with launch proposed for next Tuesday pending DAI effort and data-team scheduling. Setup will be tracked in Slack, followed by a 30-minute configuration session.

## Keywords
GrowthBook Enterprise trial, A/B experiment, Feature flag, GA4 exposure tracking, BigQuery data warehouse, Production environment
